# Fluxo

> Fluxo (Fluxo Pte. Ltd.) is a Singapore software company that builds custom operational software for small and mid-sized businesses (SMEs). Systems are built around each client's existing workflow, shown as a working demo before commitment, delivered in stages over weeks, and priced as a set-up fee plus a monthly subscription that covers hosting, security, maintenance and minor changes. Fluxo is aimed at businesses without an in-house tech team.

Contact: business@fluxo.com.sg · Ark@KB, 68 Kaki Bukit Ave 6, #04-19, Singapore 417896

## Key pages

- [Why SMEs choose Fluxo as their custom software developer in Singapore](https://fluxo.com.sg/blog/custom-software-developer-singapore-why-smes-choose-fluxo): how Fluxo works, pricing model, delivery approach, comparison with agencies, SaaS and freelancers, and FAQ
- [Services](https://fluxo.com.sg/services): Fluxo Studio (custom builds) and Fluxo's own software products
- [About](https://fluxo.com.sg/about): founders and principles
- [Contact](https://fluxo.com.sg/contact): book a free consultation
